facts.text: Doctor, the books are catalogued and the food is hot. Sit down before the portal opens.
facts.why: Not found among Wong's lines in the sources I opened. A real Wong line is 'Well, don't stop now!' (after Strange reverses time to save him). This one is printed in quote marks.

vibe.verdict: Kamar-Taj is a good setting and the Wi-Fi joke lands, but the poster sits in black bars and the menu hardly uses the film's magic.
